# datagecko_metric_types (Data Source)

Every metric type datagecko knows, with its defaults: look a type's defaults up instead of copying them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datagecko_metric_types" "all" {}

output "freshness_defaults" {
  value = jsondecode([for t in data.datagecko_metric_types.all.types : t.defaults if t.key == "freshness"][0])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `types` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `defaults` (String) Every defaulted param, as a JSON object.
- `key` (String) What a datagecko_metric's type names.
- `per_stream` (List of String) Params set on a datagecko_stream_metric, not on the instance.
- `presentation` (String)
- `required` (List of String) Params an instance must give.
